name: browser
description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
one_liner: A super lightweight, fast headless web browser built specifically so AI agents and automation scripts can browse the web without the overhead of installing Chrome.
buyer: A company running thousands of AI browser-agent sessions in the cloud who wants to cut the infrastructure cost of the browsing layer by an order of magnitude.
business_use_cases: An AI agent startup running web-scraping or browser-automation agents at scale switches to it to cut cloud compute costs versus Chromium.
A QA or testing company runs large parallel test suites faster and cheaper than with headless Chrome.
A data company doing large-scale web scraping for price or market intelligence reduces per-page cost with a leaner browser engine.

money_ideas.idea: A managed cloud browser-as-a-service charging per browsing session or minute.
An enterprise support contract for companies self-hosting it at scale.

steal_this: Spin up a simple browser-automation API wrapper around it and sell cheap per-request web scraping or screenshot access to indie developers this weekend.
